title: Joomla / WordPress Extension - acymailing.com - Online version of an email readable without the visibility check in…
description: A vulnerability in the AcyMailing Joomla/WordPress extension versions 1.0.0 through 11.1.1 allows unauthenticated attackers to access the online version of email campaigns without passing visibility checks. This includes campaigns that were never made public, unpublished campaigns after being sent, and campaigns sent to restricted audiences.
